Longevity Life Academy is delighted to invite you to The Longevity Masterclass Event of the Year.

Tonight, Tuesday, October 27, at 7:00 PM ET, live on Zoom. Reserve your seat: https://www.longevitylifeacademy.com/julie-masterclass
Second session: Saturday, November 14, at 1:00 PM ET.

Longevity Life Academy, eTeacher Group's school for healthy aging, was built on one conviction: longevity expertise should not belong only to those who can spend millions. It should be accessible to everyday Americans. That is why we bring the world's leading longevity instructors into live classes and help every student build a personalized protocol for a longer, better life.

Tonight we open our doors for a rare and unique opportunity.

Julie Gibson Clark, our Founding Faculty member and the world's second slowest ager, reveals her real protocol, live. A single mom and recruiter from Phoenix. No private lab. No team of doctors. No millions. She ages 6.5 years per decade, verified by epigenetic testing.

In 60 minutes with Julie you will learn:
• How biological aging is measured, and what truly moves it
• Her exact rules for food, sleep and movement, in numbers
• Her full daily schedule, 5:00 am to 9:00 pm
• Her four-item supplement stack, about $100 a month
• Which longevity habits are worth your money, and which are not

Standard seat: $49. The full 60-minute live masterclass.
VIP seat: $79. Adds a private 30-minute Q&A with Julie.

Choose your date at checkout. Live seats are limited. 14-day full refund.

Reserve your seat now: https://www.longevitylifeacademy.com/julie-masterclass
